verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Design view shows a generated preview of an OpenAPI spec, which covers the 'generate' half of the story for specs. Nothing in the evidence shows publishing or hosting that documentation, or generating docs from collections. Missing for 10: documented publishing/hosting of API docs, doc generation from collections, export of rendered documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate and publish API documentation from my collections or specs

citations.quote: View a generated preview of your spec in the right pane.
Build and iterate on your OpenAPI specs to design your next API.
